title: Cached diagonal Alpha equals its supported-unit composite
statement:
For every commutative coefficient ring A and every scheme S, either canonical diagonal source map alpha is the composite of the constant-object supported unit for that projection with direct image of the supported unit for the diagonal. These are the original units and their original canonical constant-sheaf comparisons.

theorem projectiveLineDiagonalAlpha_units (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (a : Bool) :
    projectiveLineDiagonalAlpha A S a =
      supportedDerivedUnit A (projectiveLineDiagonalProjection S a) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projectiveLineDiagonalProjection S a)).map
          (supportedDerivedUnit A (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)))

proof.text: Expand constantSingleSectionUnits and both supportedDerivedUnit factors. Each uses the same derivedSingleUnit for the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction, the same constant sheaf objects and the same canonical constant-sheaf pullback component at the free rank-one module. The two composites are definitionally equal.
